GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS AND EFFICIENCY
  COMMITTEE (ATTORNEY/CLIENT) AGENDA
  TUESDAY, JANUARY 21, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  THE BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 3:45 PM

Kristina Duggan, Chair
Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, Vice Chair
Mary Zendejas, Member

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT ONLINE PUBLIC COMMENTS
  AND EMAIL COMMENTS TO CITYCLERK@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 1.  25-54106  A. Existing Litigation – closed session conference with legal counsel relating to
  existing litigation pursuant to paragraph (1) of subdivision (d) of Section 54956.9 of
  the California Government Code.

  1. Amber Heads et al. v. City of Long Beach et al.; Los Angeles County Superior
  Court Case No. 22STCV17345;

  2. Workers' Compensation Claim of Alex Angotti (ADJ19042859; ADJ18010450);
  and

  3. Workers' Compensation Claim of Brogan Healy (ADJ16652664).

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Government Operations and Efficiency Committee (Attorney/Client) on
 non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless
 extended by the Chair.

 ADJOURNMENT

 I, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
 prior to the meeting.

 NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
 https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
 Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 or
 cityclerk@longbeach.gov.
